brief: Let users rename a note from the list. Each note gets an Edit button, named for its note (for example "Edit Buy milk" for screen readers), that swaps the title for a text field labelled "Title" with Save and Cancel buttons. Save sends PUT /api/notes/:id with { title } through a new function in src/api/client.ts and then shows the new title; a blank title shows "Title is required" and sends nothing. Cancel puts the old title back without saving. Add tests for it.
